rejected.libraryOrTrack: YouTube Audio Library and Creator Music
rejected.reason: Official help frames Audio Library music as music for videos and states YouTube cannot advise on off-platform issues. Creator Music licenses are explicitly non-transferable to other platforms. There is no adequate official grant for embedding and redistributing masters in a paid desktop/iOS game.

rejected.libraryOrTrack: Pixabay music as a launch catalog
rejected.reason: The platform license can cover incorporation into an app/game, but Pixabay disclaims that necessary third-party rights were obtained and warns that contributors/distributors may register tracks in Content ID. Crowd-upload provenance is a worse release risk than direct composer licensing.
The official site says it permanently closed in 2025. Exact track pages, original masters, dedication evidence, and stable download receipts cannot be captured reliably for a new commercial release.

rejected.libraryOrTrack: Free Music Archive as a blanket source
rejected.reason: Licenses vary by upload, including noncommercial and other incompatible terms. Reconsider only an individual track whose composer-owned page and exact commercial game/app license can be verified independently.

rejected.libraryOrTrack: Streaming services, stream-rips, and platform playback URLs
rejected.reason: Consumer streaming access is not a synchronization, reproduction, or game-distribution license and does not provide a redistributable master.

rejected.libraryOrTrack: CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, or personal-use-only music
rejected.reason: NonCommercial conflicts with a paid app; NoDerivatives is unsafe for synchronization/editing; ShareAlike can impose incompatible downstream obligations; personal-use terms do not grant commercial redistribution.

rejected.libraryOrTrack: Mercury, Nightchaser, Seismic, WOAH (Silverman Sound audition results from metadata)
rejected.reason: Official pages describe large drops, pounding trance, aggressive trap/dubstep, or 175 BPM jungle/vocal-sample energy. These conflict with the requirement for restrained, non-distracting instrumental table music.

requiredWrittenPermissions: Confirm in writing that a single Poker Training Pro proprietary project license covers the paid Windows desktop app plus iPhone and iPad versions, including updates and regional storefront distribution.
Confirm that embedding the selected audio master inside signed/encrypted application packages is permitted and is not treated as standalone redistribution.
If the free CC BY route is used on iOS, obtain legal review or licensor permission addressing App Store FairPlay/DRM and CC BY 4.0's no-effective-technological-measures clause.
If a Patreon or catalog-wide subscription supplies Pro licenses, archive a personalized perpetual license certificate for every selected track and confirm validity after subscription cancellation.
Confirm whether marketing trailers, store previews, livestreams, and soundtrack excerpts are included in the same project license or need separate licenses.
